title: 运行时框架作为唯一可变层：信贷流水线中LLM智能体的合规自演化与准入闸门
summary: 论文提出将LLM智能体的自演化限制在运行时框架（指令、工具调用逻辑）内，保持模型权重固定，使每次适应都可审查。通过双循环引擎与哈希链准入闸门，在模拟中仅接纳144/7449个候选变更，且未恶化历史误差；无闸门时则接纳309个有害变更。
summary_en: The paper argues self-evolving LLM agents should be confined to the runtime harness (instructions, tool-call logic) while model weights stay fixed, making every adaptation a reviewable diff. A dual-loop engine with a hash-chained admission gate admitted only 144 of 7,449 candidate changes in simulation, none worsening held-out error, versus 309 harmful changes without the gate.
